title: Investment Statement

origin.title: Sample Fidelity Portfolio Account Statement
origin.clearance_note: Fidelity's own sample statement, published on fidelity.com to show customers what a monthly statement looks like. Every page is marked '*** SAMPLE STATEMENT *** For informational purposes only'. All personal data is specimen: the account holder is 'John W. Doe, 100 Main St.', the account numbers are 111-111111, 222-222222 and 333-333333, and the phone numbers are Fidelity's and SIPC's published lines. No redaction needed.

notes: Features the page 1 portfolio reconciliation for the period: beginning value, plus additions, minus subtractions, plus change in investment value, equals ending value ($253,221.83 + $59,269.64 - $45,430.74 + $7,161.47 = $274,222.20). Transaction costs are extracted but not featured because they are a sub-line already included in subtractions. The account holder's specimen name is extracted but not featured. The first account's beginning value extracts as 880853.95 because Fidelity's PDF prints '$88,0853.95', a typo in the sample; the column arithmetic gives 88,053.95. preview_pages shows the summary, an account summary with its allocation chart, a holdings table and the estimated cash flow table, instead of the default pick, which included a page of footnotes.
